meta.description: Australian energy rebate & incentive dataset for the TradieAutomate Rebate Finder. Maintained by the Bonsai maintenance cron — diff against source pages listed per program, update amounts/eligibility/status, bump last_verified. NEVER invent figures; when a source page contradicts this file, the source wins.

vic_solar_homes_hot_water.name: Solar Homes Hot Water Rebate
vic_solar_homes_hot_water.amount_note: 50% of purchase price after STCs and VEECs, capped at $1,000; $1,400 cap for eligible locally-made systems (from 1 July 2025).
eligibility: Victorian owner-occupier of an existing property
Replacing a hot water system at least 3 years old
No prior hot water or battery rebate at the address
Not for new builds or rentals
vic_solar_homes_hot_water.how_to_claim: Apply via an authorised hot water retailer; rebate applied after STCs and VEECs.

vic_veu_hot_water.name: Victorian Energy Upgrades — Hot Water Discount
vic_veu_hot_water.amount_range: Up to $560 (heat pump) / up to $700 (efficient upgrade)
vic_veu_hot_water.amount_note: VEU discount on approved heat pump or solar hot water systems via an accredited provider. Works alongside the Solar Homes rebate.
eligibility: Install in a home or building at least 2 years old
VEU-approved product installed by accredited provider
vic_veu_hot_water.how_to_claim: Order an approved appliance through a VEU-accredited installer — discount applied at point of sale.

vic_solar_pv.name: Solar Homes Solar Panel Rebate
vic_solar_pv.amount_note: Plus optional interest-free loan. Rebate amounts held steady from 1 July 2026; households earning $150K-$210K no longer eligible from 1 July 2026.
eligibility: Household income under threshold (per Solar Victoria current rules)
vic_solar_pv.how_to_claim: Apply through Solar Victoria; panels must be on the approved product list and installed by approved retailer.

vic_battery_loan.name: Solar Homes Battery Loan (closed to new applications)
vic_battery_loan.amount_range: Interest-free loan — no longer accepting applications
vic_battery_loan.amount_note: Solar Victoria no longer takes applications for interest-free solar battery loans. Battery buyers fall back to federal programs.
vic_battery_loan.how_to_claim: N/A — see federal Cheaper Home Batteries Program instead.

nsw_ess_hot_water.name: Energy Savings Scheme — Hot Water Upgrade Incentive
nsw_ess_hot_water.amount_range: Up to $640 (electric to heat pump) / up to $330 (gas to heat pump)
nsw_ess_hot_water.amount_note: Upfront discount applied in the quote by participating installers. Actual discount varies by system size ($200-$800 typical).
eligibility: Replacing an existing electric resistance or gas hot water system
nsw_ess_hot_water.how_to_claim: Get a quote from an ESS-registered provider showing the discount applied.

nsw_home_energy_saver.name: Home Energy Saver
nsw_home_energy_saver.amount_range: Up to $4,000 discount or $15,000 zero-interest loan
nsw_home_energy_saver.amount_note: Successor to Empowering Homes (closed 2024). Covers home batteries, insulation and other efficiency upgrades.
eligibility: Technology must be on the eligible list (e.g. home batteries)
nsw_home_energy_saver.how_to_claim: Apply through participating providers / Service NSW referral.

nsw_vpp.name: Virtual Power Plant (VPP) Battery Incentive
nsw_vpp.amount_note: Sign your battery up to a demand-response contract; paid for making stored energy available at peak times.
eligibility: NSW households with an eligible battery
nsw_vpp.how_to_claim: Register with a participating VPP operator.

qld_stc_hot_water.name: Federal STC Discount — Heat Pump Hot Water
qld_stc_hot_water.amount_note: No Queensland state heat pump rebate exists in 2026 (Climate Smart Energy Savers closed December 2023). The STC discount is the only heat pump incentive, taken off the installer's quote.
eligibility: Registered heat pump/solar hot water model
STCs created within 12 months of install
qld_stc_hot_water.how_to_claim: Ask the installer to show the STC discount as a separate line on the quote.

qld_battery_booster.name: Battery Booster (closed)
qld_battery_booster.amount_note: Offered up to $4,000 to households under income caps. No replacement announced as of August 2026.
qld_battery_booster.how_to_claim: N/A — use federal Cheaper Home Batteries Program instead.

fed_cheaper_home_batteries.name: Cheaper Home Batteries Program (federal)
fed_cheaper_home_batteries.amount_note: Administered by the Clean Energy Regulator. Point-of-sale reduction on eligible 5-100 kWh battery systems; battery must be VPP-capable and on the approved list.
eligibility: Battery 5 kWh to 100 kWh nominal capacity (STCs on first 50 kWh)
Must be paired with rooftop solar (new or existing)
fed_cheaper_home_batteries.how_to_claim: Ask your installer to apply the discount at point of sale — no application form.

fed_stc_solar.name: Small-scale Technology Certificates (STCs) — Solar Panel Discount
fed_stc_solar.amount_note: Federal discount on solar PV and hot water; STCs assigned to the installer in exchange for an upfront price reduction. QLD earns slightly more due to sunnier zone.
eligibility: Eligible system on Clean Energy Regulator register
fed_stc_solar.expiry: Scales down annually (rate step-down continues to 2030)
fed_stc_solar.how_to_claim: Ask for STC discount as a separate line on the quote.
